newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUX hits new high after Friday's correction.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUX hits new high after Friday's correction.

text.p: Hungarian share prices more than regained Friday's losses on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Monday pushing the BUX index once again to a new high, traders said. The BUX index finished at 5,135.31 points, up 102.45. Share prices continued to benefit from investors' confidence in the Hungarian market and a strong dollar, traders said, adding prices were held firm mostly by local investors, rather than foreigners. "The market continues to enjoy confidence," one trader said. "However, foreigners seemed to be less active in buying, they were more on the selling side," he said. "Smaller (domestic) houses were mostly on the buying side."
